links.title: YouTube Music Likes List Downloader
links.description: 瀏覽器 Console 腳本，將 YouTube Music 喜歡歌曲清單匯出為文字檔。
links.copy_content:
(async function(){console.log('開始抓取 YouTube Music 喜歡歌曲清單');let lastHeight=0,count=0;while(true){window.scrollTo(0,document.body.scrollHeight);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));let h=document.body.scrollHeight;if(h===lastHeight){count++;if(count>2)break}else{lastHeight=h;count=0}}const rows=document.querySelectorAll('ytmusic-playlist-shelf-renderer ytmusic-responsive-list-item-renderer');let text='我的 YouTube Music 喜歡歌曲清單
總數: '+rows.length+' 首

';rows.forEach((row,i)=>{const title=row.querySelector('.title-column')?.innerText?.trim()||'';const secondary=row.querySelector('.secondary-flex-columns')?.innerText?.trim()||'';text+=(i+1)+'. '+title+(secondary?' - '+secondary:'')+'
'});const blob=new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='YouTube_Music_Likes.txt';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);console.log('匯出完成，共 '+rows.length+' 首');})();
